questions.prompt: The Ocarina of Time reviews are out tonight, and Hyrule is back in the conversation — a world you already know by heart. Which returner are you?

options.text: Back in — boots on, ready to replay it all tonight.
Steady return — a little at a time, no rush to finish.
Wandering back slow — just soaking in the familiar places.
A bit flat — the return is nice, but I'm not feeling the pull tonight.

questions.prompt: Everyone's trading theories tonight about what should actually happen in Sentinel, the newly named Elder Scrolls 6 world. How does the speculating sit with you right now?

options.text: Mind racing — theory after theory, I can't stop picturing it.
Heads-down imagining — one idea at a time, building it out.
Trading theories with everyone — half the fun is the talk.
Drifting past the theories — I'll believe it when I'm walking there.

questions.prompt: You'd planned a quiet Ocarina replay tonight, but the reviews are everywhere — takes, clips, and spoiler-adjacent chatter on every feed. What's your move?

options.text: Tuning it out and playing anyway — the game first, the takes later.
Muting the feeds — replaying at my own pace, no rush.
Calling it — the chatter is spoiling the return before it starts.
Lost in the scroll — too many takes, losing the thread of the night.

questions.prompt: It's a Sentinel theory night tonight — theories flying about what should happen in the new world, nowhere to go yet, just the imagining. If someone handled the drinks, what would you want?

options.text: Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
Something warm and slow — hot chocolate for the whole theory session.
Herbal tea — winding down while the theories do the wandering.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Tonight Hyrule's old theme is back in the air — the Ocarina reviews have that melody returning after all these years. What does that returning sound feel like around you?

options.text: A rising melody — the old theme back, lifting the whole room.
A soft, familiar tune underneath — steady, easy, holding the night.
A lone note hanging — quiet, a little heavy, the past coming back.
Notes scattering — too many memories at once, can't hold the tune.

questions.prompt: The next hour is yours, and Sentinel is still just theories — no streets to walk yet, just a named world on the horizon. What do you want that hour to feel like?

options.text: Steady progress — one theory, one idea, building the world in my head.
Settled and calm — picturing it slowly, no agenda.
Drifting — flipping between theories, not landing anywhere.
A bit heavy — sitting with how far away that world still feels.
